common: A strict {cols}x{rows} Game Boy game-art grid, every cell a single perfectly aligned solid color, {pitch_x:g} pixels wide by {pitch_y:g} pixels tall. Use only #e0f8d0, #88c070, #346856, #081820. Keep subjects readable in the two brightest shades with darkest green for the outline and eyes. No anti-aliasing, dithering, gradients, finer marks, text, border or grid lines.

knight.prompt: Full-color pixel art of this exact right-facing chibi knight, 32x32 logical pixels per frame. One solid color per cell. Blonde yellow hair and one upright hooked ahoge, light peach skin and one black eye, silver-white shoulder plates, breastplate and shin guards, royal blue tunic and blue scabbard behind the hip, brown belt, dark navy outline and boots. Large head, bold 1-pixel features, transparent background, no anti-aliasing, gradients, dithering, text, floor or grid lines.
